freeMcpMetadata.note: Metadata and prices only, never data. Not a substitute for the sponsored call.

mintPermitIssuance.note: Closed. The pre-mint gate answers 403 pre_mint_business_closed before the origin is reached; the origin own answer is 503 issuance_paused. Either way there is no public path to a permit.

nftMintOnChain.note: Contract has no pause and no admin entry. totalMinted = 0. Blocked only by the absence of permits.
nftMintOnChain.priceTiers: 0.1 BNB for mints 1-3 per address, 0.2 BNB for the 4th and 5th; MAX_QUOTA 5

doNotInfer: A mint API status field does not reflect chain state. saleOpen is computed as remaining > 0 and reads true while minting is impossible.
A 200 response does not mean JSON. Check content-type before parsing.
The demo endpoint returning 200 does not mean mint, top-up or withdrawal are open. They are not.
